text: The X-ray findings of dilated bowel segments with an absence of gas in the rectum strongly suggest a distal intestinal obstruction. To differentiate between conditions like intestinal atresia and Hirschsprung disease, have you noticed if your baby has passed any stool or mucus since birth, and does the abdomen feel firm and tense to the touch?

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on the X-ray showing distal obstruction and the absence of gas in the rectum, I need to clarify the onset of symptoms. Did your baby pass their first stool (meconium) within the first 24 to 48 hours of life, and has he passed any stool or mucus since then?
